summary: 编辑性 G0 风险优先级 / Editorial G0 risk priorities. Derived only from existing assumptions, NO-GO, rights and handoff contracts; scores are neither measured probabilities nor review grades and do not advance maturity.

dimensions.label: 数据隐私 / Data Privacy
dimensions.note: 当前回放仅使用固定无 PII 合成案例；未来数据授权、最小化、保存和撤回条件尚未建立。 / Current replay uses fixed PII-free synthetic cases only; future data controls remain unconfirmed.
dimensions.mitigation: 只接受授权、最小化、可撤回并有保存期限的数据；缺任一条件即停止验证叠层。 / Admit only authorized, minimized and withdrawable data with retention limits; otherwise stop proof.
dimensions.human_review: P06 数据、AI 与权利建议专业类型须先接受明确范围并复核；否则 NO-GO。 / Suggested P06 data-AI-rights discipline must accept an exact scope and review it; otherwise NO-GO.

dimensions.label: 实施复杂度 / Implementation Complexity
dimensions.note: 边界、权属、工程、责任、交付和 D01—D08/H01—H07 均未闭合。 / Boundaries, title, engineering, responsibility, delivery and D01-D08/H01-H07 remain open.
dimensions.mitigation: 按交接矩阵逐项替换临时输入并保留人工否决；重大缺口保持 G0/NO-GO。 / Replace provisional inputs item by item and retain human veto; major gaps keep G0/NO-GO.
dimensions.human_review: P01—P07 仅为建议专业类型；各方接受明确范围后分别复算、附条件、拒绝或删除。 / P01-P07 are suggested discipline types only; each may recalculate, condition, reject or delete after scope acceptance.

dimensions.label: 公众接受度 / Public Acceptance
dimensions.note: 现实公众反馈、参与样本和接受结果均为 0；冷读只是编辑审查。 / Real public feedback, participation samples and acceptance results are zero; cold reading is editorial only.
dimensions.mitigation: 未来过程须提供无诱导参与、同任务非 AI 路径、退出与申诉记录。 / Future work must provide non-coercive participation, same-task non-AI access, withdrawal and appeal records.
dimensions.human_review: P07 建议运营与社区专业类型和真实公众过程须在明确范围内复核；不得把编辑审查当意见。 / Suggested P07 operations-community discipline and a real public process must review an exact scope; editorial review is not opinion.

dimensions.label: 运维成本 / Operations Cost
dimensions.note: 人员、预算、班次、维护、能源与退出成本均未测量或承诺。 / Staffing, budget, rosters, maintenance, energy and exit costs are neither measured nor committed.
dimensions.mitigation: 先核算人工小时、维护责任、全周期资源与退出成本；不可负担则缩减或退役。 / Cost human hours, maintenance duty, lifecycle resources and exit first; reduce or retire if unaffordable.
dimensions.human_review: P07 与未来接受范围的工程、财务专业共同复核；在此之前不得写成可运营。 / P07 and future in-scope engineering and finance reviewers must check it; no operability claim before then.

dimensions.label: 政策不确定性 / Policy Uncertainty
dimensions.note: 官方红线、控规、审批、权属和交付权限未进入公开包；批准为 0。 / Official redlines, controls, approvals, title and delivery authority are absent; approvals are zero.
dimensions.mitigation: 只使用临时边界；D01/D02 收到官方资料后替换并复算，完成前保持 G0。 / Use provisional boundaries only; replace and recalculate after official D01/D02 inputs, remaining G0 until then.
dimensions.human_review: P01 与 P05 建议专业类型接受明确范围后复核规划与安全条件；不得推定批准。 / Suggested P01 and P05 disciplines must accept scope and review planning and safety; approval cannot be inferred.

dimensions.label: 空间争议 / Spatial Dispute
dimensions.note: 临时几何、概念包络和关系原型不是地块、建筑、车站或道路套准。 / Provisional geometry, envelopes and relational prototypes are not parcel, building, station or road alignment.
dimensions.mitigation: D01/D03 替换临时输入前不制作精确总平或工程结论；空间冲突只作待核。 / No precise masterplan or engineering conclusion before D01/D03 replace inputs; spatial conflicts remain pending.
dimensions.human_review: P01—P04 建议专业类型在接受范围后复核并可修改、拒绝或删除受影响概念。 / Suggested P01-P04 disciplines may revise, reject or delete affected concepts after accepting scope.

dimensions.label: 技术成熟度 / Technology Maturity
dimensions.note: T-02 PASS 只证明固定合成合同复演；现实模型/API、服务、人工交接和 G1 结果均为 0。 / T-02 PASS proves fixed synthetic contract replay only; real model/API, service, handoff and G1 results are zero.
dimensions.mitigation: 保持 G0；真实来源、停止/恢复、非 AI 等价和独立复测未闭合时不得推进。 / Stay at G0; do not advance before real sources, stop/recovery, non-AI parity and independent retest close.
dimensions.human_review: P05—P07 建议专业类型须在明确范围内分别复核安全、数据权利和运营。 / Suggested P05-P07 disciplines must review safety, data rights and operations within accepted scopes.

dimensions.label: 公平与包容 / Equity and Inclusion
dimensions.note: 非 AI、无屏、人工交接与无障碍目前是设计要求，真实同任务等价仍为 unknown_not_measured。 / Non-AI, screen-free, staffed and accessibility provisions are design requirements; real parity is unknown_not_measured.
dimensions.mitigation: 每种状态保留完整非 AI 路径，未来按同任务、同时间窗和可退出条件实测。 / Keep a complete non-AI path in every state; later test the same task, service window and exit conditions.
dimensions.human_review: P02 与 P07 建议专业类型和受影响群体须在明确范围内复核；不得提前声称无障碍结果。 / Suggested P02/P07 disciplines and affected groups must review an exact scope; no accessibility outcome may be claimed early.
